definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guest_link_may_upload(p_code text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.guest_link_open(p_code, 'hiring'))
     -- At most 40 files an hour come in through the link, whoever holds it (2026-10-11, review M1).
     AND (SELECT count(*) FROM storage.objects o
           WHERE o.bucket_id = 'hiring-files' AND o.name LIKE 'guest/%'
             AND o.created_at > now() - interval '1 hour') < 40;
END
$function$

name: hiring_leftovers
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hiring_leftovers(p_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN ARRAY(SELECT o.name FROM storage.objects o
                WHERE o.bucket_id = 'hiring-files'
                  AND o.created_at < now() - interval '1 day'
                  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.hiring_files f WHERE f.path = o.name)
                  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.hiring_requests r WHERE r.attachment_path = o.name)
                  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.hiring_bank_files b WHERE b.path = o.name)
                  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.hiring_bank_bin x WHERE x.path = o.name)
                ORDER BY o.created_at, o.name
                LIMIT greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit, 50), 200)));
END
$function$

name: hiring_take_upload
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hiring_take_upload(p_path text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF p_path IS NULL OR p_path !~ '^(files|resumes)/[0-9a-f-]{36}/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,160}$'
     OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM storage.objects o WHERE o.bucket_id = 'hiring-files' AND o.name = p_path) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'That file did not arrive. Please upload it again.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.hiring_files f WHERE f.path = p_path)
     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.hiring_bank_files b WHERE b.path = p_path)
     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.hiring_bank_bin x WHERE x.path = p_path) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'That file is already on a record.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
END
$function$

name: hr_doc_file_present
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_doc_file_present(p_path text, p_folder text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN p_path IS NOT NULL
     AND p_path LIKE p_folder || '/%'
     AND strpos(p_path, '..') = 0
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM storage.objects o WHERE o.bucket_id = 'hr-documents' AND o.name = p_path);
END
$function$

hr_documentation_leftovers
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_documentation_leftovers()
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.has_any_action(ARRAY['documentation.edit']) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Deleting files needs Documentation · Edit' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN coalesce((
    SELECT array_agg(x.name ORDER BY x.created_at, x.name)
      FROM (SELECT o.name, o.created_at
              FROM storage.objects o
             WHERE o.bucket_id = 'hr-documents'
               AND (storage.foldername(o.name))[1] IN ('documents', 'letters', 'publish', 'drive')
               AND public.hr_doc_file_unused(o.name)
               AND public.hr_doc_readable_by_hr(o.name, o.owner_id)
               AND (o.created_at < now() - interval '1 day'
                    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.hr_documents d WHERE d.file_path = o.name)
                    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.hr_person_letters l WHERE l.file_path = o.name)
                    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.member_memos m WHERE m.attachment_path = o.name)
                    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.hr_drive_files f WHERE f.file_path = o.name))
             ORDER BY o.created_at, o.name
             LIMIT 100) x
  ), '{}'::text[]);
END
$function$

name: hr_drive_bin_files_gone
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_drive_bin_files_gone(p_paths text[])
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_n integer;
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.hr_drive_file_events (file_id, what, actor_id, actor_name, note)
  SELECT f.id, 'File deleted', NULL, 'Data center', f.file_name
    FROM public.hr_drive_files f
   WHERE f.file_path = ANY (coalesce(p_paths, '{}'::text[])) AND f.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM storage.objects o WHERE o.bucket_id = 'hr-documents' AND o.name = f.file_path)
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.hr_drive_file_events e WHERE e.file_id = f.id AND e.what = 'File deleted');
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_n = ROW_COUNT;
  RETURN v_n;
END
$function$

name: hr_drive_orphans
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_drive_orphans(p_limit integer DEFAULT 100)
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN coalesce((
    SELECT array_agg(x.name ORDER BY x.created_at, x.name)
      FROM (SELECT o.name, o.created_at
              FROM storage.objects o
             WHERE o.bucket_id = 'hr-documents' AND o.name LIKE 'drive/%'
               AND o.created_at < now() - interval '1 day'
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.hr_drive_files f WHERE f.file_path = o.name)
             ORDER BY o.created_at, o.name
             LIMIT greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit, 100), 500))) x
  ), '{}'::text[]);
END
$function$
